articles.headline: King Robinson wins Menards 150
articles.dek: Official finish, points and how the championship looks after the race.
articles.body:
King Robinson won Menards 150 at Kansas Speedway, starting P2 and leading 71 laps. Nicholas Hoggeton finished second and Samuel Riggs was third.

The race ran 200 laps with 4 cautions.

James Baker was the biggest mover, gaining 24 spots from P28 to P4.

Caleb Guerrier leads the championship with 3107 points, 16 ahead of Daniel Stavchanksy.
articles.author: Jamie Kowalski
